name: Vault 11: Voter's Dilemma
oracle_text:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — For each opponent, you create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.
II, III — Each player secretly votes for up to one creature, then those votes are revealed. If no creature got votes, each player draws a card. Otherwise, destroy each creature with the most votes or tied for most votes.
blocked_sentences: II, III — Each player secretly votes for up to one creature, then those votes are revealed. If no creature got votes, each player draws a card. Otherwise, destroy each creature with the most votes or tied for most votes.

needs.what: a vote op: each player (in turn order, here secretly, revealed simultaneously) chooses up to one object from a selector (here any creature on the battlefield), the tally is bound so later effects can read it -- a condition for 'no object got votes' and a selector for 'each object with the most votes or tied for most votes' -- feeding an if/else of draw for each player vs destroy over the top-voted set
needs.why_existing_wont_do: choose_permanents and choose_player are made by one player only, join_forces collects payments not choices, and for_each_player wrapping choose_permanents has no way to aggregate the choices into a per-object vote count nor a selector for the most-voted (tied included) objects; no condition reads 'no votes cast'
